source_excerpt:
2.2.11     It shall only be possible for the user who initiated the call to talk, other users can only 
listen. (M) 
Group voice calls

evidence_span.text: only be possible for the user who initiated the call to talk

clean_requirement: In a group voice call, only the initiating user shall be allowed to speak; all other users shall be restricted to listening.
smelly_requirement: In a group voice call, users shall be able to communicate by voice.
removed_condition: The permission rule restricting speech to the initiator is removed.
contamination_notes: The source directly supplies the clean permission rule. The smelly wording preserves the broad voice-call intent but removes the speaker restriction, creating the silent authorization gap shown by the discovery design.
licensing_notes: The ARTA repository is MIT-licensed, but EIRENE/UIC source specifications may have separate copyright and standards-distribution terms. Verify the original document terms before publishing excerpts beyond this research repository.

smell.injection_rule: replace the explicit speaker authorization condition with a general voice-communication statement

reference_implementations.clean:
def evaluate(speaker_is_initiator):
    return 'speak' if speaker_is_initiator else 'listen'

test_gen.criterion: only the call initiator may speak; all other participants may listen
